title: Optimization & enhancement of KGeCl3-based perovskite solar cells through charge transport layer engineering
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2525-2544
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08299K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zulqarnain Abbasi, Shayan Tariq Jan, Mamoona Safeer, Muhammad Imran, Anees Ur Rehman
The effect of novel charge transport layers on the behavior and performance of KGeCl3 perovskite solar cells was investigated with CSTO-KGeCl3-nPB structure outperforming the rest by achieving 29.3% efficiency.
